event.thermal: first crossing T>344 K from below; starts at sample end
event.censoring: exclude post-first-event and final incomplete horizons
event.bifurcation: refined equilibrium spectral crossing with nondegeneracy; never a temperature label

control.optimizer: deterministic coordinate search from ProcessLab main; not global SQP equivalence

threshold_selection: calibration trajectories only; maximize event recall subject to false onset <=0.5/h; abstain if no admissible threshold
scope: simulation only; synthetic scenario mixture, no accident probabilities or plant safety certificate
pilot_amendment: Pilot used 12 earlier evaluation seeds. Final evaluation uses entirely new 300000/400000 ranges after models and thresholds frozen. No further tuning.
